description: This file defines the GatewayEndpointID enum with utility functions for handling NWEndpoint objects, including generating stable IDs and pretty descriptions, as well as normalizing service names.

methods.name: stableID
methods.description: Generates a stable string identifier for an NWEndpoint, specially handling service endpoints to maintain consistency.

methods.name: prettyDescription
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of an NWEndpoint, decoding special characters.

methods.name: normalizeServiceNameForID
methods.description: Normalizes service names by decoding escapes and trimming whitespace.
